title: Live Preview: start scene/frame override is ignored (scene override no-ops at runtime)
description:
RESOLVED (agent-1339).

ROOT CAUSE (confirmed firsthand, matches QA notes gap (c)):
preview/startAt.ts buildStartScript() emitted gotoAndPlay("SceneName", frame) for a
later scene, but the AS2 compiler (packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts gotoAndPlay/
gotoAndStop builtins) only supports the single-arg NUMERIC form: it compiles args[0],
pushes it, emits ActionGotoFrame2 (0x9F), and DROPS args[1]. The scene name was pushed
as a FRAME LABEL; scenes are emitted as SceneAndFrameLabelData (tag 86), not frame
labels, so GotoFrame2 resolved nothing and stayed on frame 1 — the start-scene override
silently no-oped. (Single-scene numeric frame override already worked.)

FIX (option 2 — compiler-free, scene->absolute-frame mapping):
buildStartScript now emits an ABSOLUTE frame number. The compiled main timeline is the
concatenation of every scene's frames, so scene S / frame F maps to
  absFrame = (sum of frameCount of scenes 0..S-1) + F
and we emit gotoAndPlay(absFrame) / gotoAndStop(absFrame). The per-scene length now uses
the SAME layerFrameCount (@flash/core) the SWF compiler uses (compiler/depth.ts
sceneFrameCount), so the offset lands exactly where the compiler placed each scene (the
old local sceneFrameCount used only max-keyframe-index, which could under-count and
mis-place later scenes). Also made the start-change re-seek immediate (useLivePreview.ts
request({immediate:true})) to match its comment.

VERIFICATION:
- Build: pnpm --filter './packages/**' build — green.
- Unit (authoring-ui): pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run => 1028 passed
  (78 files). livePreviewStartAt.test.ts now 16 tests incl. multi-scene absolute-frame
  cases AND a bytecode decoder that compiles the produced script via compileAS2 and
  asserts ActionPush(SI32) operand == absolute frame + GotoFrame2 SceneBiasFlag=0.
- Unit (swf): 1466 passed. (core): 5517 passed; the only 3 failures are pre-existing
  fixture-absence (fixtures/flash8-empty.fla not present in any worktree — ENOENT,
  unrelated to this change).
- E2E (Ruffle acceptance, own dev server on :1421 since :1420 held by agent-a0dc386):
  apps/desktop/e2e/live-preview-start-scene.spec.ts — 2-scene doc, scene 0 fully RED,
  scene 1 ("Blue Scene") fully BLUE. Default start: player renders RED (red=146300,
  blue=0). Set start-scene=1 via preview-start-scene control: player renders BLUE
  (blue=76450 > red). PROVEN to have teeth: temporarily reverting to the buggy
  scene-name form makes the override case stay RED (blue=0) and the test FAILS.
  Existing live-preview.spec.ts + preview-key-isolation.spec.ts still pass.
- Docs: docs/34-live-preview.md Start-from-scene/frame section updated.
